body.p: . src/function_library_element_map.c (part element_map) implements fn:element-to-map-plan, fn:element-to-map and fn:map-to-element (F&O 4.0, section 14.6).

item.p: No recursion, no new machinery (). fn:element-to-map keeps one element slot per node of the subtree and walks the node indices twice: in document order it chooses layouts (a child is converted only when its parent's layout converts children, so a plan's error below an xml element is never reached), in reverse document order it builds values, whose children are then done. fn:element-to-map-plan walks the same ranges once. fn:map-to-element keeps a stack of frames and sends tree builder events to a new arena tree that destroys itself (, ); the xml layout parses through the document loader and copies with sxml_tree_builder_copy_node. Grouping, duplicate keys and plan lookup use XDM maps () as indices, nothing of its own.

Untyped input only: sxml is not schema-aware, so the schema-based layouts (14.6.6) and the nilled forms on the element-to-map side never apply; xsi attributes are ignored, and plan analysis skips xsi:nil="true" elements as 14.6.4 says.

Choices the text leaves open, following QT4: without a plan entry, attributes stay xs:untypedAtomic while simple element content gets the inferred type (14.6.3, 2 gives {"a":{"@x":"1", "#content":2}}); a cast failure under a prescribed type is FOJS0010 even with a fallback; a leading zero after an optional sign makes a string. In fn:map-to-element, matching a value against a layout looks one level down only (list members against the child name's candidates by form), so it needs no recursion; elements in a namespace from Q{uri} keys use the default namespace, attributes made-up prefixes ns0, ns1, ...; prefixes of p:local keys resolve against the static namespaces of the innermost unit (as the static base URI, ).

QT4: fn-element-to-map 179/181 run, fn-element-to-map-plan 20/20, fn-map-to-element 223/228. Open: element-to-map-101 and -507 assert ?a?… on the context value, which the driver does not set (XPDY0002); map-to-element-014 and -021 expect XQuery's decoding of & in string literals under XP40; -120 and -121 need fn:serialize.
